scripts.test:contracts: tsc -p packages/shared/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/shared/tsconfig.contracts.json && node packages/shared/tests/harness-policy-registry.mjs && node packages/shared/tests/harness-artifact-access.mjs && node packages/shared/tests/harness-eval-contract.mjs && node packages/shared/tests/harness-manifest.mjs && node packages/shared/tests/tool-manifest.mjs
scripts.eval:harness: cd services/ai && UV_CACHE_DIR=/tmp/vibe-learner-uv-cache uv run python -m app.services.harness_eval_runner
scripts.eval:harness:pr: cd services/ai && UV_CACHE_DIR=/tmp/vibe-learner-uv-cache uv run python -m app.services.harness_eval_pilots --profile pr
scripts.bench:harness: cd services/ai && UV_CACHE_DIR=/tmp/vibe-learner-uv-cache uv run python -m app.services.harness_performance_benchmark
scripts.test:ai: cd services/ai && UV_CACHE_DIR=/tmp/vibe-learner-uv-cache uv run python -m unittest discover -s tests
scripts.check: npm run test:contracts && npm run check:web && npm run test:web:reliability && npm run eval:harness:pr
scripts.check:release: npm run check && npm run test:ai && npm run build:web
